name: Capital Knot City, United States
description: The invented capital of the United Cities of America in Death Stranding, on the east coast where Sam's journey starts and ends. The game gives no real city; the name suggests the old capital, so the pin stands on Washington, D.C. as a guess. The game's moss, black sand and lava fields are widely compared to Iceland, where Kojima went scouting in 2014.
